quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Ah! Excuse me! You, the golden-haired adventurer! Please wait a moment!

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: Oh, no, it's nothing like that! I just wanted to ask if you happen to have a collection of poems about love.

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: Look, I'm an incredible bard — maybe the most incredible in all of Mondstadt after Lord Barbatos himself! Seriously, I'm amazing!

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: But there's Linus... that pesky bard never seems to admit I'm better! He shows up all the time, reciting poems at me nonstop! No matter how you look at it, he's obviously trying to one-up me.

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: And the worst thing? Every single poem is about love and romance... things I've never even touched!

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: So I'm taking matters into my own hands. I'm going to write a love poem so epic that Mondstadt will never forget it! That'll teach him what real talent is!

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: Of course... since I've been dedicating all my time to the pursuit of truly great art, I haven't had a chance to experience love myself.

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: So if you happen to have a poetry collection about love, please sell it to me! I just need to flip through them for a bit. Once I do, inspiration will start pouring in. With talent like mine, that's practically inevitable!

choices.text: I'm afraid I can't help. I have other things to attend to. Goodbye.

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: No, no! I didn't mean for you to help. After all, if everyone asked a stranger for help every time something went wrong, nobody would ever dare travel!

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: Ahem. I just wanted to ask if you happen to have a book of love poems.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hand over "The Song of Ay-Khanoum.")

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Whoa, what a beautiful book! Alright, let's see what it says...

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: "...No throne stands without serpents beneath it, no rose blooms free of thorns. Drink the bitterness to the final drop, Ferigees, and with those sweet eyes of yours, promise me... promise me..."

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Uh... wait, how do you pronounce this one again?

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's definitely too profound for me! My tongue's already in a knot! I'll just take it home and read it slowly later... Thanks, golden-haired adventurer!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hand over the "Revelations of Divine Love.")

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Oh! I've heard of this one before. It's a poetry collection from the Church of Favonius, right?

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Let me see... "Her soul is a field aflame, pouring its fiery song into the wind. Between the stars, the moon, and the radiant sun, even my own light is burned by her glow..."

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: What kind of poem is that? It's honestly a bit unsettling... and the Church of Favonius clearly doesn't know much about poetry. I mean, stars, the moon, and the sun all appearing together? As if!

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Well, that settles it! My confidence is back. If that's the level of poetry in this book, then even I could do better. I'll buy it. Thanks, golden-haired adventurer!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hand over "The Dream of Rhonabouillet.")

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Oh, a Fontaine poetry collection! Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Traveling back to the past... the court of the Lochknight... and he falls in love with a maid at first sight...?

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Pfft! This is hilarious! You get the chance to go back in time, and the only thing on your mind is chasing romance with someone your own ancestor's age?

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Oh, so that's the point. It's a love poem!

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Hah, I get it now. Love really does make people lose their senses. Anyway, I'll buy it and read it properly later. Thanks, golden-haired adventurer!

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Oh! Golden-haired adventurer! Did you bring any love poetry worthy of inspiring a genius like me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hand over "Ballads of the Squire.")

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Oh, the story about the Ragnvindr Clan, right?

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: But it doesn't really work as a love poem. That Fontaine musician never actually falls in love with the squire knight. They both just end up dead.

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: And romance is really something best left to the living. So... got any other poetry collections?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hand over "Before Sun and Moon.")

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Huh? A stone tablet? Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: "Pigeons... pigeons..."

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: ...Uh, how do you even read this next one? Ugh, never mind. Even if I wanted it, there's no way I'd be able to carry it anywhere! Got another poetry collection?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hand over "Breeze Amidst the Forest.")

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Haha, Breeze Amidst the Forest? Come on, I'm a brilliant bard. You think I wouldn't know that one? I've read it cover to cover more times than I can count! Haven't you got something new?

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Haha, thank you, golden-haired adventurer! You're my hero, my greatest hero!

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: I can feel inspiration surging in my head already, like the winds of Stormterror's Lair, the miasma of Chenyu Vale, and the thunder over Seirai Island — it's all about to burst out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds very dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Heh, just wait and see! I'm writing all these ideas down right now!

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Linus's pretentious poems won't stand a chance. Once my masterpiece is finished, taverns all across Teyvat will be buzzing with my name!
